purpose: LIVE federation orchestrator + candidate model registry over the frozen V2 FL stack: authenticated, persisted, deterministic, engineering-only. One FL_SINGLE_RUN = 8 clients x 3 rounds x 24 genuine local updates through the unchanged Coordinator/aggregate_weighted_deltas, exact V2-FL-005 parity, exactly one CAPSTONE_FL_CANDIDATE with structural validation and sandbox-only governance. No candidate is served, deployed or promoted.

upstream.frontend_and_released_runtime: frozen during CAP-007 (zero change); Federation pages stay NOT YET ENABLED (CAP-008 owns them)
upstream.protection_audit: scripts/cap_007_protected_audit.py (strict: every entry file byte-identical except the control-plane registries and the lifecycle test; new files only in explicit CAP-007 namespaces)

contract_reconciliation.problem: CAPSTONE_FEDERATION_CONTRACT_V1 maps ROUND_AGGREGATED to AGGREGATING -> CANDIDATE_CREATED for every round, i.e. three candidates for a 3-round run, while the frozen V2-FL-005 lineage carries the round-1/2 aggregates forward as the next round's base state.
contract_reconciliation.resolution: additive CAPSTONE_FEDERATION_CONTRACT_V2 (contracts/capstone/federation_v2.json): AGGREGATING additionally -> COMPLETED for non-final rounds; no vocabulary or algorithm change; the V1 file is not edited
contract_reconciliation.client: additive CAPSTONE_FL_CLIENT_ADAPTER_V2 (CAP-006 V1 is FL_INIT-only and stays unchanged)

client_successor_semantics: one adapter per client per round over the CAP-006 local buffer; the round base is accepted only after lineage verification (round 1 = FL_INIT_V2 digest; round N>1 = digest of the immediately preceding committed round state); train/envelope code is inherited from V1; MODEL_V2_FINAL and candidates are refused; no copied training loop
round_events_order: per round: federation.status RUNNING, round.status COLLECTING, client.status DATA_READY x8, round.status LOCAL_TRAINING, per client (canonical order): client.status TRAINING, client.training_progress 0, client.training_progress 1, client.status UPDATE_READY, client.update_ready, client.status SUBMITTED; round.status UPDATES_READY, round.status AGGREGATING, secagg.status, aggregation.status

final round: round.status CANDIDATE_CREATED, candidate.created, round.status VALIDATING, candidate.validation RUNNING, candidate.validation PASSED|FAILED (checks = ids of passed checks), candidate.governance, round.status ACCEPTED_TO_SANDBOX|REJECTED, round.status COMPLETED
training_progress_policy: only the start (0.0, examples 0) and completion (1.0, examples_seen) milestones; intermediate progress is never invented

candidate.artifact: data/capstone/fl_candidates/<id>/state.bin + metadata.json (written serialise -> verify -> temp dir -> atomic rename -> then the SQL row)

governance_rule: CREATED -> VALIDATION_PENDING -> VALIDATING -> ACCEPTED_TO_SANDBOX (all five checks pass: validation PASSED, sandbox IN_SANDBOX) | REJECTED; scientific_promotion=false and production_deployed=false always

secagg_shadow.scope: round 1 only; authoritative aggregation stays PLAIN

replay: a REPLAY run replays the events of the most recent COMPLETED LIVE_RUN of the same owner with the same algorithm/secagg_mode/rounds; source recorded in artifact metadata; zero training/submit/aggregate/SecAgg/candidate/governance; federation.status run_type is REPLAY
restart_resume: round-boundary checkpoints (run id, protocol id, cohort identity, algorithm, secagg mode, planned rounds, last committed round, state sha, state-file sha, event count); a RUNNING run with a valid checkpoint resumes the next round in a fresh process, otherwise FAILED; orphan candidate artifacts of the run are removed before resume

persistence.events: run event JSONL in the federation artifact store; no per-event SQL table

api.concurrency: at most one active LIVE run globally (409 INVALID_STATE FEDERATION_RUN_ALREADY_ACTIVE)

forbidden: model efficacy or any classification metric
scientific promotion or deployment of a candidate

locality_claim.allowed: eight logically isolated local client datasets on one demonstration machine; the federation server receives model updates rather than raw local training examples

canonical_runs.chronology: all canonical and scenario runs execute after the freeze commit

preserved_disclosures: CAP-005 Clerk WebSocket cookie path unverified
CAP-005 accessibility audit not equivalent to formal WCAG certification
CAP-005 canonical UI evidence using ACCELERATED simulation
out_of_scope: deploying/promoting a candidate or changing DEFAULT_RUNTIME_BINDING_V2
held-out scientific evaluation or any efficacy metric
training on website user monitoring data
chronology_disclosure: The CAP-007 implementation was written and its targeted tests run BEFORE this freeze commit (as in earlier phases). Before the freeze the canonical harness and the evidence builder were dry-run end to end into a scratch directory outside the repository (and one canonical live run was briefly written to reports/capstone/cap_007 and deleted) to find harness/evaluator defects; none of that output is committed and no canonical result file exists in the freeze commit. The two recorded canonical runs, all scenarios, the mutation controls, the regression and the criteria evaluation are produced only after the freeze commit.
environment: Python 3.11 venv outside the repo; no GPU; CI neither queried nor triggered
